breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to compute the elongation using the exact axial deformation integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the spatially varying area A(x) = A0·(1 + k·x/L). It does not mention replacing A(x) with an arithmetic mean area, thereby correctly avoiding the flawed approximation present in the incomplete prompt.
